description: Reach an authorized computer's filesystem and terminal from ChatGPT through Desktop Commander's Remote MCP. The app relays a secure connection to a machine the user controls so ChatGPT can inspect files, run commands, manage processes, edit local documents, and automate development workflows from chat. Users stay in control of which devices are connected and can disconnect them at any time.
